notes: Actual screenshot contact pages 1-8 show consistent Minecraft HUD first-person and occasional third-person perspectives, different parallel constructed stages and custom visible models. This strongly suggests in-game-style staging but does not attribute proprietary tools/software.
Baked visible English color-coded subtitles are prominent, but native voice interpretation, precise speech timing, music editing and Foley are NOT independently verified.
A '15-minute' countdown in the final room changes from ~14:51 at 20:34 to ~00:21 at 24:22, strong evidence storytime is condensed by edit or accelerated timer. Exact technique not verified.
Unverified third-party named mod details (Techguns, Custom Security, cartoon cat package, Forge/Fabric) are hypotheses only.
No JJ/Mikey skins, Maizen graphics, branded Android/iPhone product look or Cartoon Cat copyright properties should be copied into CineFactory original video.
